changelog:
- Initial release of "fuxin-custom-tool", a sample skill for Fuxin Office showcasing enterprise-customized Word document workflows.
- Demonstrates how to combine multiple existing MCP Word scenario tools (write_report, unify_terminology, highlight_and_comment, checklist_review) into reusable, enterprise-specific processing pipelines.
- Provides several example pipelines, such as one-click contract review and automatic report generation, using sequential invocation of scenario tools.
- No new underlying tools are added; the skill focuses solely on orchestration and workflow customization.
- Includes detailed descriptions, example parameters, and extension guidance for enterprises to create their own tailored automation flows.
display_name: 福昕 Office 企业工具
summary: 福昕 Office 企业工具让企业把重复、标准的文档处理流程变成可复用的“一键按钮”。以法务合同评审为例，原本需要依次完成写报告、统一术语、高亮批注、清单审查四步，现在可以组合成一个“一键生成合同评审报告”的自定义工具，员工只需在对话框中说出指令，系统即自动按标准流程执行并输出结果。
